title: Shape Zoo (variant & visit)
hints: std::visit(visitor, shape) calls the visitor with whatever alternative the variant currently holds.
The 'overloaded' helper builds a visitor from several lambdas: template <class... Ts> struct overloaded : Ts... { using Ts::operator()...; };
Then: std::visit(overloaded{ [](const Circle& c) { ... }, [](const Rect& r) { ... }, [](const Triangle& t) { ... } }, shape). All lambdas must return the same type.
Triangle area (Heron): p = (a + b + c) / 2, area = sqrt(p (p-a) (p-b) (p-c)). Circle: std::numbers::pi * r * r. Counting circles: std::holds_alternative<Circle>(shape).
